$comment: ADR-0185: the Jira status check (scripts/jira-status-check.mjs, workflow jira-status.yml). Each SLM key a PR names (title, branch, a Closes/Refs line) must be in one of these statuses before the merge: Ready for Release, which QA sets when the PR passed. A Released issue passes only for a PR that changes test files only. Only the owner's waiver label lets another PR through.
